Actual parent and32 integral mapped building parts control scale; the campanile has its own actual footprint. The separately mapped convent/cloisters, Pazzi Chapel, refectory and neighboring city buildings remain independent. No copied sculpture, frescoes, tombs, text or furnished interiors.
